items.title: Sonnet 5.5
items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5.5，引发基准与定价之争
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 5.5, Igniting Benchmark and Pricing Debate
items.summary: Anthropic announces Claude Sonnet 5.5, prompting extensive Hacker News discussion on its capabilities, benchmarks, and competition from Chinese models.

items.title: World Labs Is Joining AMD
items.title_zh: AMD 收购李飞飞创办的 World Labs，交易据报达 80 亿美元
items.title_en: AMD Acquires Fei-Fei Li's World Labs in Reported $8B Deal
items.summary: AMD is acquiring World Labs, Fei-Fei Li's spatial intelligence startup, in a major AI industry consolidation move reportedly valued at $8 billion.

items.title: How GLM5.3 Sparse Attention Affects HBM Memory Usage
items.title_zh: GLM-5.3 稀疏注意力如何影响 HBM 内存占用
items.title_en: How GLM-5.3 Sparse Attention Affects HBM Memory Usage
items.summary: An in-depth analysis of how GLM-5.3's sparse attention mechanisms affect HBM memory usage and inference efficiency, exploring techniques like KV cache offloading and IndexShare.

items.title: Functional Gradient Descent with Adaptive Representations [R]
items.title_zh: NeurIPS 论文为函数梯度下降形式化"自适应表示"框架
items.title_en: NeurIPS Paper Formalizes Adaptive Representations for Functional Gradient Descent
items.summary: A NeurIPS-accepted paper introduces 'adaptive representations' for functional gradient descent, formalizing approximation schemes that provably converge to the global minimizer and outperform neural networks by up to an order of magnitude.

items.title: 太空激光无线输能将迎首次轨道测试
items.title_zh: Star Catcher 拟首次在轨测试两颗卫星间的激光无线输能
items.title_en: Star Catcher to Attempt First Orbital Laser Power Transfer Between Satellites
items.summary: Star Catcher plans to launch a prototype on a SpaceX rocket to attempt the first in-orbit laser power transfer between two separate satellites.

items.title: SpaceX 星舰首次入轨，部署卫星后提前返航
items.title_zh: SpaceX 星舰首次入轨，部署 26 颗星链卫星后提前返航
items.title_en: SpaceX Starship Reaches Orbit for First Time, Deploys 26 Starlink Satellites
items.summary: SpaceX's Starship reportedly reached orbit for the first time, deployed 26 Starlink satellites, then returned early after an engine shutdown, in a flight aimed at validating capabilities for NASA's Artemis lunar program.

items.title: 快手可灵 4.0 将于 10 月上线
items.title_zh: 快手可灵 4.0 宣布 10 月上线，支持 4K 与 30 秒生成
items.title_en: Kuaishou's Kling 4.0 AI Video Model to Launch in October
items.summary: Kuaishou announced Kling 4.0, its next-generation AI video model, will launch in October with Kling 4.0 Flash already in limited testing as of September 28, supporting 4K, 10-bit HDR, multimodal inputs, and up to 30-second video generation.
